decisions.reason: As a medium-sized German machinery maker, the firm would usually give a newly launched niche system more than one year to build sales, even if it was only mentioned rather than heavily promoted on the website.
A low-pressure injection pump fits the firm's core machinery business and its own product page suggests a stronger commercial commitment, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
Although website visibility was more limited, a low-pressure material transfer pump is a plausible adjacent product in industrial equipment and would typically be retained while the market develops.

Dedicated web presentation indicates the firm sees fire protection flow monitoring as a meaningful offer, and established German machinery firms usually do not abandon such products after only a short market test.
